name: LGND ENERGY
old_description: Your home is one of the biggest investments you will ever make. Utilizing solar energy will help improve the value of a home while giving you benefits while living in the home. Solar panels from LGND Energy are of the highest quality on the market in New Mexico. We have been working to provide roofing and solar solutions for homeowners for many years. Using solar energy gives you the freedom to control your power production, lower your energy bill, and help improve the environment.
about:
LGND Energy was founded in 2019 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by brothers Elmer and Octavio Reyna. After years leading sales teams at larger solar firms, the pair wanted to bring a family-oriented culture to both their representatives and customers, so they launched their own solar sales dealership with a mission to pass savings directly to homeowners.

The company designs, sells, and installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems across Albuquerque and Bernalillo County. Its services include roof consultations to verify structural readiness, full permitting and HOA coordination, and battery-backup installation using Tesla Powerwall 3 and Enphase units. Field crews, often including father-and-son teams, also fit critter guards and clean arrays.

LGND serves homeowners, small and large businesses, and multi-family properties throughout central New Mexico. Reviews cite projects ranging from single-family rooftops to commercial arrays, with the team managing city permits and utility interconnection on the customer's behalf.

The founders frame their differentiation around a low-pressure sales model: representatives complete extensive training and are compensated to prioritize customer fit over volume. The brothers started the business to reward reps for hard work while delivering the “family feel” they missed at prior employers.
